name: whatsapp-api-sdk
description: Typed contract and client for the whatsapp-api REST service
//: One entrypoint, `dist/`, in the workspace and when published: `npm publish` does not apply `publishConfig.exports`, and `pnpm deploy --prod` with `files: ["dist"]` would copy a package whose exports named a file it did not ship. The cost is that `dist/` must exist before anything typechecks against this package, which the root `check`/`test` scripts and `api`/`mcp`'s own `build:deps` both guarantee by building first.
//build: The build script is `tsc -b`, not `-p`, because `api` and `mcp` each call it from their own `build:deps` and the root fans those out in parallel. Build mode compares input and output timestamps and writes nothing when `dist/` is already current, so the concurrent case is a no-op rather than two compilers emitting into the same directory. Build mode always writes a `.tsbuildinfo`; `tsconfig.json` redirects it into the root `node_modules/.cache/` so nothing untracked appears in the package and nothing extra ships.
